title: Sonic CD (JP/EU) - Quartz Quadrant Zone (Good Future)
description:
completing the Quartz Quadrant port circle because why not

This is the Japanese Good Future theme of Quartz Quadrant from Sonic CD. A very peaceful theme that can be used quite well for a peaceful grassland overworld or level.

Note: @15 is removed to make ARAM space, so you cannot use Yoshi in a level with this song.
